claims.quote: The UK’s position could not be clearer.
claims.statement: The UK's position on Ukraine is clear.

claims.quote: Ukraine has repeatedly demonstrated it is serious about peace
claims.statement: Ukraine has repeatedly demonstrated that it is serious about peace.

claims.quote: Russia has repeatedly rejected full and partial ceasefires
claims.statement: Russia has repeatedly rejected full and partial ceasefires.

claims.statement: Russia is continuing attacks on Ukrainian civilians and energy.

claims.statement: The UK fully supports US-led efforts to secure a just and lasting peace in Ukraine.
